critical_code_review_comments: SiteVisitForm.js is now >1100 lines — strongly recommend splitting per-step components for maintainability (carried over from iter-32).

ProposedSolutionSection.js computes derived metrics on every keystroke via useMemo — efficient. Live calc verified deterministic: net_cost = total_cost - subsidy, payback = net_cost / (annual_eb_savings + annual_diesel_savings). Net cost field is readonly+auto, which is correct UX.

Backend update_project notes_only detection list correctly covers all non-notes fields including selected_items/manual_costs/status. Status preserved on notes-only PUT for completed projects — verified.

Lazy migration in GET /projects/{id} reads `additional.shadow_analysis_notes` only when `notes` is None/empty. Does NOT auto-write back to `notes` field — purely read-time projection. That's safe and lossless, but if a user appends notes via POST /notes (without first calling Edit→Save), the original `notes` field stays empty in DB while history accumulates. Recommend writing back on first edit (already happens in Edit→Save flow since handleSaveNotes calls updateNotes).
